description:
"Intensify your physical presence to gain Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.

While this effect persists, each piece of Heavy Armor worn decreases the cost of Break Free by |cffffff5|r%.

Also grants you immunity to knockback and disabling effects for |cffffff6|r seconds, but reduces your Movement Speed by |cffffff65|r% for the duration."
